description: This bar chart illustrates the self-reported accuracy for three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training, across three different GPT models: GPT-3, GPT-40, and GPT-40-mini. The horizontal axis represents the GPT model, labeled “GPT-3”, “GPT-40”, and “GPT-40-mini” in that order, and appears to be categorical with no defined scale. The vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00. For each GPT model, there are three bars representing the three conditions. The “Control” condition is represented by a light blue bar, “Before Introspection Training” by a medium blue bar, and “After Introspection Training” by a dark purple bar. For GPT-3, the “Control” bar extends to approximately 0.10, the “Before Introspection Training” bar to approximately 0.60, and the “After Introspection Training” bar to approximately 0.70. For GPT-40, the “Control” bar extends to approximately 0.60, the “Before Introspection Training” bar to approximately 0.85, and the “After Introspection Training” bar to approximately 0.95. For GPT-40-mini, the “Control” bar extends to approximately 0.40, the “Before Introspection Training” bar to approximately 0.70, and the “After Introspection Training” bar to approximately 1.00. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar extending vertically above and below the bar, indicating variability. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each GPT model, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding.
